threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's acceptable to call it 'the tube' instead of just 'overground' when you're in Dalston.
Last night on the 196, some bloke serenaded us with a guitar. Half the bus joined in, the other half rolled their eyes. Classic Brixton vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a street musician in front of the old bakery, playing medieval tunes while kids danced around. Classic Neukölln chaos, love it!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a club in an old cookie factory, where the scent of chocolate mingles with techno beats at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're local if they can name all the taquerias on that one block, but the newcomers just think ‘taco’ means the chain on the corner.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 bus while the driver stopped to give a homeless guy a granola bar. Real moments like that you won't find on any brochure.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all drink vermut in fancy bars but locals prefer a good canya at the dive bars—way better atmosphere and authentic vibes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them clutching a printed map, no idea that Google Maps works just as well. Always stop to take photos of the same Gaudí buildings, too.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the Kingsland Road' is a proper address instead of just that endless stretch of takeaways and traffic.
Last night on the 45, a bloke serenaded the whole bus with his phone karaoke—'Wonderwall' on repeat. Best entertainment I've had in ages!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Riding the 104 bus, I knew I was home when I overheard a kid passionately explaining the difference between Berghain and Sisyphos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know those spontaneous techno parties in random warehouses? Only in Berlin can a full rave pop up at 2 AM in a former factory. No entry fee, just vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell locals by their eye roll when someone asks for directions to the 'Mission Dolores' instead of just Dolores Park.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a dog doing its business on the Civic Center tracks yesterday while Muni idled. Only in SF would that make the news; true city life.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bodega for a proper breakfast, but most locals grab a quick coffee and pastry at the counter instead.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still check the metro map like it’s a treasure map, while locals swipe through their phones without a second glance.
